# Reference screenshots

Screenshots of the original (pre-WFF) watch face, release 1.16 (versionCode 32), used as
the target when tuning the WFF layout.

- Device: `Wear_OS_Large_Round_API_30` emulator (Wear OS 3, 454×454 round). Wear OS 5 and
  later refuse to run legacy watch faces.
- Settings: defaults (green theme, Limelight, worn on left wrist, 24-hour clock, colorful
  ambient, small date, no complications).
- Time: Wednesday 11 November 2026, 23:21:41.

| File | Mode |
|---|---|
| `legacy-1.16-active.png` | Interactive |
| `legacy-1.16-ambient.png` | Ambient (seconds hidden) |
